name: Doodles and Digits: How It's Math
original_name: Doodles and Digits: How It's Math
overview: Doodles and Digits is an engaging and educational series that aims to make math relatable and accessible to upper elementary students by connecting math concepts to real-life situations. Each episode of the show explores different math concepts, such as fractions, geometry, or decimals, and demonstrates how it can be used in practical applications in the world around us.
